# ADR trigger notes — R4.15d (2026-10-22)

Ticket 164k assigns trigger dispositions for ADR-0292 and ADR-0293 (the
fetch-related triggers; landed ADR bodies are frozen — BM-ADR-01; the
precedent is R4.9's `2026-10-22-adr-0292-0293-0294-0308-trigger.md`).

## ADR-0292 (S4.1 registry service rulings) — NOT FIRED

Trigger text: *"Revisit D3/D6 if a deployment needs a foreign system
outside the closed `ForeignSystem` sum or a non-`plugin_manifest/1`
export target …; revisit D2 if `TrustRootPolicy` gains chain-head
anchors …; revisit D4 if the ledger's append-time endorsement check
ever accepts a non-durable subject…"*

R4.15d lands remote `locations[]` fetch under the adopted
`FetchTrustPolicy` (a `hh-bundle-fetch-trust/1` MUST-data record —
`admission_classes` / `admitted_origins` / `accepted_signers` /
`require_ledgered_arrival`). That is a *fetch-site* trust record on the
bundle plane, not the registry plane's `TrustRootPolicy` — the D2
trigger names chain-head anchors *on that record* and
`FetchTrustPolicy.accepted_signers` are `SignerRef` coordinates, not
`ChainRef` anchors, so `trusted_anchors().chain_heads` stays exactly
the wired-but-empty member ADR-0292 left it. No `ForeignSystem` arm, no
export target, no endorsement-check change — D3/D6/D4 untouched.

## ADR-0293 (S4.2 experiment & bundle rulings) — FIRED-ANSWERED
(ruling 4's DF-S4.2-1 discharged)

Trigger text: *"DF-S4.2-1/2 landing (remote fetch transports or the
remaining foreign vocabularies) reopens ruling 4/7's deferral rows…"*

DF-S4.2-1 lands here: ruling 4's parked half — remote transports
(`http:`, `ipfs:`, signed-URL carriers) refusing `Refused{fetch =
transport_pending}` — is superseded by the adopted §trust-fields set.
`manifest.locations[]` remote members now materialise through
`hh-bundle::trust::admit` (first_party allowlisted `https:` origins,
`signed_url` presigned/placeholder carriers, `content_addressed`
`ipfs:`-class) riding the `hh_env::egress` `EgressMediator` and the
ADR-0365 `hh_tls` home; every attempt lands `bundle.member.fetched`
durable-before-deposit; cleartext `http:` and credentialed locators
refuse typed (`transport_refused`), `expires` is enforced
(`location_expired`), off-list origins `origin_not_admitted`, absent
policy `policy_absent`, `ipfs:` `transport_unsupported` — the
`transport_pending` interim is gone, exactly the row's discharge test
("fetches every member under the declared trust policy (or refuses
with the policy's typed reason); the transport_pending refusal is
gone"). Ruling 4's *deferral row* is discharged; the ruling's pool
half stands unchanged. Ruling 7's DF-S4.2-2 discharged at R4.9; the
rulings on `may_transition_to`/`superseded` sources (2/3) and
engine-side assembly (6) are untouched — no `results.arm` widening, no
scoped-assembly-in-engine caller appeared.
